/* globals adobe, BI, Visitor */
(function() {
  var logEvent = (window.BI && BI.console && BI.console.build('ADB VisitorAPI')) || Function.prototype;

  var oneTrustConsent = (() => {
    let loaded;
    const _consentCATs = {
      8: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C8%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Social Media',
      },
      7: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C7%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Content Selection & Measurement',
      },
      6: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C6%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Device Storage',
      },
      4: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C4%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Targeted Advertising'
      },
    };

    const parseCookie = () => {
      loaded = (() => {
        let present = document.cookie.match(/^(.*;)?\s*OptanonConsent\s*=\s*[^;]+(.*)?$/);
        return present && present.length >= 1;
      })();

      let consentCookie =
        document &&
        document.cookie &&
        document.cookie
          .split(';')
          .map(s => s.trim())
          .find(s => s.startsWith('OptanonConsent'));

      Object.entries(_consentCATs).forEach(([k,v]) => {
        _consentCATs[k].enabled = v.pattern.test(consentCookie);
      });
    };
    parseCookie();

    return {
      loaded,
      enabledCATs: () => {
        let enabled = [];
        Object.entries(_consentCATs).forEach(([k,v]) => {
          if (v.enabled) enabled.push(k);
        });
        return enabled;
      },
      isEnabled: (category) => {
        return _consentCATs[category]?.enabled ?? false;
      },
      refresh: () => {
        parseCookie();
      }
    };
  })();

  //OneTrust GDPR Consent BEGIN
  var buildConfig = () => {
    var config = {};
    let { loaded, isEnabled } = oneTrustConsent;

    if (loaded) {
      config.previousPermissions = {};
      if (!isEnabled(8)) {
        // CAT 8: Social Media
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.LIVEFYRE] = false;
      }
      if (!isEnabled(7)) {
        // CAT 7: Content Selection & Measurement
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.AAM] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.ANALYTICS] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.CAMPAIGN] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.ECID] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.MEDIA_ANALYTICS] = false;
      }
      if (!isEnabled(6)) {
        // CAT 6: Storage
        config.disableThirdPartyCookies = true;
      }
      if (!isEnabled(4)) {
        // CAT 4: Targeted Advertising
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.ADCLOUD] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.TARGET] = false;
      }
      if (isEnabled(4) && isEnabled(7)) {
        // Enable all categories as opted in
        // Effectively what was being done previously by adobe.optIn.approveAll();
        Object.keys(adobe.OptInCategories).forEach((category) => {
          config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories[category]] = true;
        });
      }
      if (isEnabled(6)) {
        config.disableThirdPartyCookies = false;
      }
    }
    return config;
  };
  //OneTrust GDPR Consent END

  var visitor = Visitor.getInstance('8CF467C25245AE3F0A490D4C@AdobeOrg', {
    trackingServer: 'o.fandango.com', // same as s.trackingServer
    trackingServerSecure: 'os.fandango.com', // same as s.trackingServerSecure
    marketingCloudServer: 'o.fandango.com',
    marketingCloudServerSecure: 'os.fandango.com',
    doesOptInApply: () => {
      // Broad strokes enables/disables opt-in flow
      return window?.Optanon?.GetDomainData?.().ForceConsent ?? !document.cookie.split(';').some((entry) => entry.includes('region=USA'));
    },
    disableThirdPartyCookies: true, // can be overwritten by builtConfig
    ...buildConfig(),
    // preOptInApprovals: preOptInApprovalsConfig,
    // previousPermissions: previousPermissionsConfig,
    // isOptInStorageEnabled: false
  });

  // Assign visitor instance to window in case it's a dependency elsewhere
  window.visitor = visitor;
  visitor.getVisitorValues((data) => {
    logEvent('Identity Values', data);
  });
})();

        resolve(undefined);
      }, timeLimit);

      BI.waitForObjAvailable(['__CNBC_META_DATA.user'], (timeLimit/100), function() {

/*global __CNBC_META_DATA, mps, adobe, Optanon, BI */
//Omni Setup
var s={};
var s_account='';
if (document.location.host == 'www.cnbc.com' || document.location.host == 'dealornodeal.cnbc.com' || document.location.host == 'activate.cnbc.com') {
  s_account='fancnbcglobal';
}else{
  s_account='fancnbcglobaldev';
}
var s_omniServer='o.fandango.com';
var s_omniSecureServer='os.fandango.com';
var s_linkInternalFilters='javascript:,cnbc.com,taboolainternal,cnbcevents.com,cnbccouncils.com,activate.cnbc.com';
var currentURL = window.location.href || '';
var requestorId = 'CNBC'
var device = ''
var pathname = ''
var activationPageTVEContentHub = 'Adobe Pass'
var activationPageTrackingEvents = {
    ACTIVATION_SCREEN: 'clientlessActivationScreen',
    CONFIRMATION_SCREEN: 'clientlessConfirmationScreen',
    MVPD_SELECTION     : 'mvpdSelection',
    MVPD_SELECTED      : 'mvpdSelected',
    ADOBE_PASS_LANDING : 'adobePassLanding',
    AUTHN_TRACK        : 'authnTrack',
    PASS_SIGNIN        : 'passsignin'
}

function deleteBedrockCookie() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return;
  }
  document.cookie = 'bedrocktrk=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT;path=/';
  document.cookie = 'bedrocktrk=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT;path=/;domain=.cnbc.com';
}

window.s = new AppMeasurement(s_account);

// Set up logic for App Measurement on new CNBC activation page
window.addEventListener('activationPageLoaded', function(event) {
  var trackEventType = event.detail
    _trackDeviceActivationPageLoadEvent(trackEventType)
})
window.addEventListener('activationPageTrackAuthEvent', function(event) {
  var {trackEventType, mvpdId, additionalAppMeasurementContextVariables} = event.detail
  _trackAuthEvents(trackEventType, mvpdId, additionalAppMeasurementContextVariables)
})

function _getDeviceType(pathName) {
  var ottPlatforms = ['firetv', 'androidtv', 'samsungtv', 'viziotv', 'x1', 'roku', 'tvos']
  ottPlatforms.forEach(platform => {
    if(pathName.includes(platform)){
      device = platform
    }
  })
}

function _setUpActivationPageTVE() {
    var s=s_gi(s_account)
    s.trackingServer=s_omniServer
    s.trackingServerSecure=s_omniSecureServer
    const days = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday']
    const timeEST = this._getDateTimeEST()
    const date = timeEST.getDate() + '-' + (timeEST.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + timeEST.getFullYear()
    const platform = this._isMobile() ? 'Mobile' : 'PC'
    _getDeviceType(window.location.pathname)
    s.pageName = requestorId+'- Watch Full Episodes |'+requestorId+'| Enter your activation code'
    s.contextData['tve.minute'] =
        timeEST.getHours() + ':' + timeEST.getMinutes()
    s.contextData['tve.hour'] = timeEST.getHours()
    s.contextData['tve.day'] = days[timeEST.getDay()]
    s.contextData['tve.date'] = date
    s.contextData['tve.platform'] = platform
    s.contextData['tve.domain'] = window.location.host
    s.contextData['tve.contenthub'] = activationPageTVEContentHub
    s.contextData['tve.app'] = device
    s.contextData['tve.clientlessdevice'] = device
    s.contextData['tve.passnetwork'] = requestorId
    s.contextData['tve.network'] = requestorId
}

function _trackPage(pageName) {
  _setUpActivationPageTVE()
  if (pageName) {
      s.pageName = pageName
  }
  if (s.contextData['tve.contenthub'] != activationPageTVEContentHub) {
    Object.keys(s.contextData).forEach((key) => {
      if (key === 'tve.pass') {
          delete s?.contextData[key]
      }
    })
  }
  s.linkTrackEvents = ''
  s.linkTrackVars = ''
  s.events = ''
  s.linkTrackEvents = ''
  s.t()
}

function _updateContextData(additionalVars) {
    var keys = '';
    s.contextData = {...s.contextData, ...additionalVars}
    Object.keys(additionalVars).forEach(key => keys = ',contextData.' + key)
    return keys;
}

function _trackEvent(events, linkName, linkVars) {
  _setUpActivationPageTVE()
  if (linkName.endsWith("Selected")){
      const brand = window.location.href.includes('ms.now') ? 'MSNOW' : 'CNBC'
      s.pageName = brand+":PC:" + s.pageName
  }
  s.events = events
  s.linkTrackEvents = events
  s.linkTrackVars = linkVars + ',contextData.tve.minute,contextData.tve.hour,contextData.tve.day,contextData.tve.date,contextData.tve.platform,contextData.tve.domain,contextData.tve.app,contextData.tve.passnetwork,contextData.tve.network'
  s.pev2 = linkName
  s.tl(true, 'o', linkName)
}

function _trackAuthEvents(eventType, mvpd_id, additionalVars) {
  s.contextData = {};
  s.contextData['tve.app'] = 'website'
  var platform = _isMobile() ? 'Mobile' : 'PC'

  if(additionalVars) {
    additionalKeys = _updateContextData(additionalVars);
  }

  s.contextData['tve.contenthub'] = activationPageTVEContentHub
  s.contextData['tve.passnetwork'] = requestorId
  s.contextData['tve.network'] = requestorId
  s.contextData['tve.clientlessdevice'] = device

  switch (eventType) {
    case activationPageTrackingEvents.MVPD_SELECTION: {
      s.contextData['tve.passmvpdselector'] = 'true'
      s.contextData['tve.title'] = 'Open MVPD Selector'
      s.contextData['tve.network']   = requestorId;
      _trackPage(requestorId + ':' + platform + ':Pass:' + 'Open MVPD Selector')
      break
    }
    case activationPageTrackingEvents.MVPD_SELECTED: {

      if (

      ) {

          authModalType = null,
          modalName = null,
        } = data.dataset;

        const eventData = convertEventData({
          analyticId,

          modalName,
        });

        // Snowplow pixel
        if (eventData.snowplowId) {
          const addParams = new URLSearchParams({
            ...pixelConfig['snowplow'].staticParams,
            aid: eventData.snowplowId, // snowplow app id
          });

          const pixelUrl = new URL(`?${addParams.toString()}`, pixelConfig['snowplow'].baseURL);
          addPixel(pixelUrl.toString(), 'snowplow', [{ name: 'alt', value: '' }]);

        if (eventData.theTradeDeskId) {

How Facebook Marketplace is keeping young people on the platform 
 Meta’s Facebook’s influence remains strong globally, but younger users are logging in less. Only 32% of U.S. teens use Facebook today, down from 71% in 2014, according to a 2024 Pew Research study. However, Facebook’s resale platform Marketplace is one reason young people are on the platform.

“I only use Facebook for Marketplace,” said Mirka Arevalo, a student at Buffalo University. “I go in knowing what I want, not just casually browsing.”

Launched in 2016, Facebook Marketplace has grown into one of Meta’s biggest success stories. With 1.1 billion users across 70 countries, it competes with eBay and Craigslist, according to BusinessDasher.

“Marketplace is the flea market of the internet,” said Charles Lindsay, an associate professor of marketing at the University of Buffalo. “There’s a massive amount of consumer-to-consumer business.”

Unlike eBay or Etsy, Marketplace doesn’t charge listing fees, and local pickups help avoid shipping costs, according to Facebook’s Help Center.

“Sellers love that Marketplace has no fees,” said Jasmine Enberg, VP and Principal Analyst at eMarketer. “Introducing fees could push users elsewhere.”

Marketplace also taps into the booming resale market, projected to hit $350 billion by 2027, according to ThredUp.

“Younger buyers are drawn to affordability and sustainability,” said Yoo-Kyoung Seock, a professor at the College of Family and Consumer Sciences at the University of Georgia. “Marketplace offers both.”

A key advantage is trust; users’ Facebook profiles make transactions feel safer than on anonymous platforms like Craigslist, according to Seock.

In January 2025, eBay partnered with Facebook Marketplace, allowing select eBay listings to appear on Marketplace in the U.S., Germany, and France. Analysts project this will drive an additional $1.6 billion in sales for eBay by the end of 2025, according to Wells Fargo.

“This partnership boosts the number of buyers and sellers,” said Enberg. “It could also solve some of Marketplace’s trust issues.”

While Facebook doesn’t charge listing fees, it does take a 10% cut of sales made through its shipping service, according to Facebook’s Help Center.

Marketplace isn’t a major direct revenue source, but it keeps users engaged.

“It’s one of the least monetized parts of Facebook,” said Enberg. “But it brings in engagement, which advertisers value.”

Meta relies on ads for over 97% of its $164.5 billion revenue in 2024.

“Marketplace helps Meta prove younger users still log in,” said Enberg. “Even if they’re buying and selling instead of scrolling.”

By keeping users engaged, Marketplace plays a key role in Facebook’s long-term strategy, ensuring the platform remains relevant in a changing digital landscape.

class="InlineImage-imageEmbedCaption"></div><div class="InlineImage-imageEmbedCredit">Drs Producoes | E+ | Getty Images</div></div></div></div><div class="group"><p>CNBC's <a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/01/best-financial-advisors.html">Financial Advisor 100 list</a> is determined through a blend of data analysis and editorial review.</p><p>As an initial screening, data provider AccuPoint Solutions analyzes core data points from its proprietary database of registered investment advisors, or RIAs, as well as the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's regulatory <a href="https://adviserinfo.sec.gov/" target="_blank">database</a>. Firms that don't meet CNBC's proprietary criteria are removed from the list.</p><div style="height:100%" class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><p>This year's analysis used an initial list of 40,563 RIA firms. The list was eventually cut to 1,015 RIAs that met CNBC's proprietary criteria.</p></div><div class="group"><div class="RelatedContent-relatedContent" id="SpecialReportArticle-RelatedContent-1"><div class="RelatedContent-container"><div class="RelatedContent-nonCollapsibleContent"><h2 class="RelatedContent-header">More from CNBC's Financial Advisor 100:</h2><div class="group"><p><em>Here's a look at more coverage of CNBC's Financial Advisor 100 list of top financial advisory firms for 2025:</em></p><ul><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/01/best-financial-advisors.html">CNBC's Financial Advisor 100: Best financial advisors, top firms for 2025 ranked</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/01/financial-advisor-100-methodology-2025.html">How we determined the Financial Advisor 100 ranking for 2025</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/17/tax-withholding-2026.html">Bessent says to adjust paycheck withholdings, but mistakes may trigger a tax bill</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/05/stock-market-drops-investors.html">S&P 500 shrugs off 1% daily drops all the time. Investors can, too, advisors say</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/05/iran-war-investors-stability.html">Where investors can look for stability as the Iran war rattles markets</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/05/iran-war-market-volatility-retirement.html">What the Iran war market turmoil means for those nearing retirement</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2026/02/03/trump-salt-deduction-taxes.html">Bigger SALT cap may 'drive higher refunds,' tax expert says — who benefits</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2026/01/23/financial-risks-of-supporting-adult-children.html">In an affordability crunch, Gen Z adults lean on their parents for financial help</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2026/01/06/aca-subsidy-cliff-tax-bills.html">ACA subsidy cliff may mean 'astronomical tax bills' for many, CFP says</a></li><li><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2025/10/01/parsons-capital-management-ranked-one-financial-advisor-100.html">How CNBC's No. 1 financial advisor uses a 'white glove approach' in tumultuous times</a></li></ul></div></div></div></div></div><div class="group"><p>CNBC sends an extensive email survey to all those firms that meet the initial criteria to gather more details about their practice. CNBC applies a layer of editorial review, clarifying firm entries as needed and verifying responses against the SEC regulatory database and other publicly available resources.</p><p>AccuPoint Solutions then applies CNBC's proprietary weighted criteria to refine the list and rank the firms.</p><p>A firm's inclusion on the list is based solely on this methodology. CNBC receives no compensation from placing financial advisory firms on our list. Additionally, a firm's or advisor's appearance on our ranking does not constitute an individual endorsement by CNBC of any firm or advisor.</p></div><h2 class="ArticleBody-subtitle"><a id="headline0"></a>Data that goes into CNBC's Financial Advisor 100 </h2><div class="group"><p>AccuPoint Solutions uses a variety of primary data points, either as a minimum baseline or within a range, to eliminate those firms that do not meet CNBC's requirements. For example, any firm that has a disclosure with the SEC such as a regulatory violation or customer dispute is automatically disqualified from the ranking.</p><div style="height:100%" class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><p>Once the initial list is compiled, weightings are also applied accordingly. </p><p>These data points include:</p><ul><li>Advisory firm's regulatory/compliance record</li><li>Number of years in the business</li><li>Number of certified financial planners</li><li>Number of employees</li><li>Number of investment advisors registered with the firm</li><li>Ratio of investment advisors to the total number of employees</li><li>Total assets under management</li><li>Percentage of discretionary assets under management</li><li>Total accounts under management</li><li>Number of states where the RIA is registered</li><li>Country of domicile</li></ul><p><em>CNBC receives no compensation from placing financial advisory firms on our </em><a href="https://www.cnbc.com/top-rated-wealth-management-firms/"><em>Financial Advisor 100 list</em></a><em>. Additionally, a firm's or advisor's appearance in our ranking does not constitute an individual endorsement by CNBC of any firm or advisor.</em></p></div><div id="ArticleBody-MobileAdhesion" Firms that don't meet CNBC's proprietary criteria are removed from the list. This year's analysis used an initial list of 40,563 RIA firms. The list was eventually cut to 1,015 RIAs that met CNBC's proprietary criteria. CNBC sends an extensive email survey to all those firms that meet the initial criteria to gather more details about their practice. CNBC applies a layer of editorial review, clarifying firm entries as needed and verifying responses against the SEC regulatory database and other publicly available resources. AccuPoint Solutions then applies CNBC's proprietary weighted criteria to refine the list and rank the firms. A firm's inclusion on the list is based solely on this methodology. CNBC receives no compensation from placing financial advisory firms on our list. Additionally, a firm's or advisor's appearance on our ranking does not constitute an individual endorsement by CNBC of any firm or advisor. Data that goes into CNBC's Financial Advisor 100 AccuPoint Solutions uses a variety of primary data points, either as a minimum baseline or within a range, to eliminate those firms that do not meet CNBC's requirements. For example, any firm that has a disclosure with the SEC such as a regulatory violation or customer dispute is automatically disqualified from the ranking. Once the initial list is compiled, weightings are also applied accordingly.           try {

          try {

              return true;
            }

          } catch (error) {
            return false;
          }

      };

        intervalId = setInterval(function() {
          attempts++;
          
          if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
            clearInterval(intervalId);
            return;
          }
          
          // Wait for mParticle to be fully initialized with Identity
          if (!window.mParticle || !window.mParticle.Identity) {
            return;

          // Poll for Analytics SDK - check multiple possible globals

            (window.amplitude && typeof window.amplitude.getInstance === 'function') ||
            (window.analytics && typeof window.analytics.track === 'function') ||
            (window._satellite && window._satellite._monitors)
          );
          
          if (!isAnalyticsSdkReady) {
            return;
          }
          
          // Wait for Web Experiment SDK to be loaded
          if (!window.experiment || typeof window.experiment.init !== 'function') {
            return;
          }

          clearInterval(intervalId);
          
          // Initialize Web Experiment SDK now that all dependencies are ready
          try {
            window.experiment.init();
          } catch (error) {
            return;
          }
        }, 300);
      };
      
      init();
    })();

/* globals adobe, BI, Visitor */
(function() {
  var logEvent = (window.BI && BI.console && BI.console.build('ADB VisitorAPI')) || Function.prototype;

  var oneTrustConsent = (() => {
    let loaded;
    const _consentCATs = {
      8: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C8%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Social Media',
      },
      7: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C7%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Content Selection & Measurement',
      },
      6: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C6%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Device Storage',
      },
      4: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C4%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Targeted Advertising'
      },
    };

    const parseCookie = () => {
      loaded = (() => {
        let present = document.cookie.match(/^(.*;)?\s*OptanonConsent\s*=\s*[^;]+(.*)?$/);
        return present && present.length >= 1;
      })();

      let consentCookie =
        document &&
        document.cookie &&
        document.cookie
          .split(';')
          .map(s => s.trim())
          .find(s => s.startsWith('OptanonConsent'));

      Object.entries(_consentCATs).forEach(([k,v]) => {
        _consentCATs[k].enabled = v.pattern.test(consentCookie);
      });
    };
    parseCookie();

    return {
      loaded,
      enabledCATs: () => {
        let enabled = [];
        Object.entries(_consentCATs).forEach(([k,v]) => {
          if (v.enabled) enabled.push(k);
        });
        return enabled;
      },
      isEnabled: (category) => {
        return _consentCATs[category]?.enabled ?? false;
      },
      refresh: () => {
        parseCookie();
      }
    };
  })();

  //OneTrust GDPR Consent BEGIN
  var buildConfig = () => {
    var config = {};
    let { loaded, isEnabled } = oneTrustConsent;

    if (loaded) {
      config.previousPermissions = {};
      if (!isEnabled(8)) {
        // CAT 8: Social Media
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.LIVEFYRE] = false;
      }
      if (!isEnabled(7)) {
        // CAT 7: Content Selection & Measurement
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.AAM] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.ANALYTICS] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.CAMPAIGN] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.ECID] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.MEDIA_ANALYTICS] = false;
      }
      if (!isEnabled(6)) {
        // CAT 6: Storage
        config.disableThirdPartyCookies = true;
      }
      if (!isEnabled(4)) {
        // CAT 4: Targeted Advertising
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.ADCLOUD] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.TARGET] = false;
      }
      if (isEnabled(4) && isEnabled(7)) {
        // Enable all categories as opted in
        // Effectively what was being done previously by adobe.optIn.approveAll();
        Object.keys(adobe.OptInCategories).forEach((category) => {
          config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories[category]] = true;
        });
      }
      if (isEnabled(6)) {
        config.disableThirdPartyCookies = false;
      }
    }
    return config;
  };
  //OneTrust GDPR Consent END

  var visitor = Visitor.getInstance('8CF467C25245AE3F0A490D4C@AdobeOrg', {
    trackingServer: 'o.fandango.com', // same as s.trackingServer
    trackingServerSecure: 'os.fandango.com', // same as s.trackingServerSecure
    marketingCloudServer: 'o.fandango.com',
    marketingCloudServerSecure: 'os.fandango.com',
    doesOptInApply: () => {
      // Broad strokes enables/disables opt-in flow
      return window?.Optanon?.GetDomainData?.().ForceConsent ?? !document.cookie.split(';').some((entry) => entry.includes('region=USA'));
    },
    disableThirdPartyCookies: true, // can be overwritten by builtConfig
    ...buildConfig(),
    // preOptInApprovals: preOptInApprovalsConfig,
    // previousPermissions: previousPermissionsConfig,
    // isOptInStorageEnabled: false
  });

  // Assign visitor instance to window in case it's a dependency elsewhere
  window.visitor = visitor;
  visitor.getVisitorValues((data) => {
    logEvent('Identity Values', data);
  });
})();

(function() {
  function resolveUser({timeLimit = 3000 } = {}) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      let didTimeout = false;

      let timeout = setTimeout(function() {
        didTimeout = true;
        resolve(undefined);
      }, timeLimit);

      BI.waitForObjAvailable(['__CNBC_META_DATA.user'], (timeLimit/100), function() {
        if (didTimeout) return;

        clearTimeout(timeout);
        resolve(__CNBC_META_DATA.user);
      });
    });
  }
  function loadParsely(){
    const cnbcParsely = {
      autotrack: false,
      onReady: function() {
        const getUserType = async function () {
          const user = await resolveUser();
          let usertyperesult;
          if (!user) {
            usertyperesult = 'anonymous';
          } else if (user.isPro) {
            usertyperesult = 'logged-in-pro';
          } else if (user.isInvestingClubUser) {
            usertyperesult = 'logged-in-investingclub';
          } else if (user.isPlusUser) {
            usertyperesult = 'logged-in-plus';
          } else {
            usertyperesult = 'logged-in';
          }
          return usertyperesult;
        };
        const getContentType = function () {
          let isInvestingClubContent = false;
          let contentypestatus;
          if (__CNBC_META_DATA && __CNBC_META_DATA.contentClassification && __CNBC_META_DATA.contentClassification.includes('investingClub')) {
            isInvestingClubContent = true;
          }
          if (__CNBC_META_DATA && __CNBC_META_DATA.contentClassification && __CNBC_META_DATA.contentClassification.includes('cnbcplus')) {
            contentypestatus = 'cnbcplus';
          }
          else if (__CNBC_META_DATA.premium == true && __CNBC_META_DATA.native != true){
            contentypestatus = 'Pro';
          }
          else if (isInvestingClubContent) {
            contentypestatus = 'investingclub';
          }
          else {
            contentypestatus ='free';
          }
          return contentypestatus;
        };
        getUserType().then((userType) => {
          PARSELY.updateDefaults({
            data: {
              user_type: userType,
              content_type: getContentType(),

          });
          PARSELY.beacon.trackPageView();
        });

    window.PARSELY = window.PARSELY ? Object.assign( window.PARSELY, cnbcParsely ) : cnbcParsely;
    (function(d) {

          mps.site = 'cnbc.com';

        case location.hostname == 'stg-02deal.cnbc.com':

          break;
        case (location.hostname.indexOf('qa') != -1 ) && (location.hostname.indexOf('buffett.cnbc.com') != -1):

          mps.site = 'sandbox.buffett.cnbc.com';
          break;
        case (location.hostname.indexOf('qa') != -1 ) && (location.hostname.indexOf('acorns.com') != -1):
        case (location.hostname.indexOf('dev') != -1 ) && (location.hostname.indexOf('acorns.com') != -1):
          mps.site = 'sandbox.grow.acorns.com';
          break;
        case (location.hostname.indexOf('qa') != -1 ) && (location.hostname.indexOf('cnbc.com') != -1):
        case (location.hostname.indexOf('dev') != -1 ) && (location.hostname.indexOf('cnbc.com') != -1):
        case (location.hostname.indexOf('sandbox') != -1 ) && (location.hostname.indexOf('cnbc.com') != -1):
        case (location.hostname.indexOf('localhost') != -1 ):
          mps.site = 'sandbox.cnbc.com';
          break;
        default:
          mps.site = location.hostname;
      }
      if (!window.PARSELY){
        window.PARSELY = {video:{autotrack:false}};
      }
      if(!location.href.includes('/datapreview/')){
        const site = mps.site,
          b = d.body,

        e.innerHTML = '<span id="parsely-cfg" data-parsely-site="'+site+'"></span>';

      e.src = h + '//' + u + '/p.js'; r.appendChild(e);
    })('script', 'parsely', document);
    (function() {
      if(__CNBC_META_DATA && (__CNBC_META_DATA.id == 100003784 || __CNBC_META_DATA.id == 404 || __CNBC_META_DATA.id == 405)) {
        return;
      }
      let count = 0;
      const timer = setInterval(function(){
        if(count > 60 || (window.PARSELY && PARSELY.config && PARSELY.config.parsely_site_uuid) ) {
          clearInterval(timer);
          profileBeacon();

        count++;

      function profileBeacon() {

      }

    (function () {
      window.parselyOnRoute = window.parselyOnRoute || function (event) {
        if (window.PARSELY && window.PARSELY.beacon) {

function deleteBedrockCookie() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return;
  }

})

})

function _getDeviceType(pathName) {
  var ottPlatforms = ['firetv', 'androidtv', 'samsungtv', 'viziotv', 'x1', 'roku', 'tvos']
  ottPlatforms.forEach(platform => {
    if(pathName.includes(platform)){
      device = platform
    }
  })
}

function _setUpActivationPageTVE() {
    var s=s_gi(s_account)
    s.trackingServer=s_omniServer
    s.trackingServerSecure=s_omniSecureServer
    const days = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday']
    const timeEST = this._getDateTimeEST()
    const date = timeEST.getDate() + '-' + (timeEST.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + timeEST.getFullYear()
    const platform = this._isMobile() ? 'Mobile' : 'PC'
    _getDeviceType(window.location.pathname)
    s.pageName = requestorId+'- Watch Full Episodes |'+requestorId+'| Enter your activation code'
    s.contextData['tve.minute'] =
        timeEST.getHours() + ':' + timeEST.getMinutes()
    s.contextData['tve.hour'] = timeEST.getHours()
    s.contextData['tve.day'] = days[timeEST.getDay()]
    s.contextData['tve.date'] = date
    s.contextData['tve.platform'] = platform
    s.contextData['tve.domain'] = window.location.host
    s.contextData['tve.contenthub'] = activationPageTVEContentHub
    s.contextData['tve.app'] = device
    s.contextData['tve.clientlessdevice'] = device
    s.contextData['tve.passnetwork'] = requestorId
    s.contextData['tve.network'] = requestorId
}

function _trackPage(pageName) {
  _setUpActivationPageTVE()
  if (pageName) {
      s.pageName = pageName
  }
  if (s.contextData['tve.contenthub'] != activationPageTVEContentHub) {
    Object.keys(s.contextData).forEach((key) => {
      if (key === 'tve.pass') {
          delete s?.contextData[key]
      }
    })
  }
  s.linkTrackEvents = ''
  s.linkTrackVars = ''
  s.events = ''
  s.linkTrackEvents = ''
  s.t()
}

function _updateContextData(additionalVars) {
    var keys = '';
    s.contextData = {...s.contextData, ...additionalVars}
    Object.keys(additionalVars).forEach(key => keys = ',contextData.' + key)
    return keys;
}

function _trackEvent(events, linkName, linkVars) {
  _setUpActivationPageTVE()
  if (linkName.endsWith("Selected")){
      const brand = window.location.href.includes('ms.now') ? 'MSNOW' : 'CNBC'
      s.pageName = brand+":PC:" + s.pageName
  }
  s.events = events
  s.linkTrackEvents = events
  s.linkTrackVars = linkVars + ',contextData.tve.minute,contextData.tve.hour,contextData.tve.day,contextData.tve.date,contextData.tve.platform,contextData.tve.domain,contextData.tve.app,contextData.tve.passnetwork,contextData.tve.network'

  s.tl(true, 'o', linkName)
}

function _trackAuthEvents(eventType, mvpd_id, additionalVars) {

  s.contextData['tve.clientlessdevice'] = device

    case activationPageTrackingEvents.MVPD_SELECTION: {
      s.contextData['tve.passmvpdselector'] = 'true'
      s.contextData['tve.title'] = 'Open MVPD Selector'
      s.contextData['tve.network']   = requestorId;

    }

      s.contextData['tve.passselected'] = 'true'
      s.contextData['tve.passmvpd'] = mvpd_id
      s.contextData['tve.platform'] = platform;

    case activationPageTrackingEvents.PASS_SIGNIN: {
      s.contextData['tve.passsignin'] = 'true'
      s.contextData['tve.passmvpd']   = mvpd_id;
      s.contextData['tve.title'] = 'Provider Sign-In'
      s.contextData['tve.network']   = requestorId
      _trackPage(requestorId + ':' + platform + ':Pass:Provider Sign-In')
      break
    }
  }
}

function _trackDeviceActivationPageLoadEvent(eventType) {
    _setUpActivationPageTVE()
    switch (eventType) {
      case 'clientlessActivationScreen': {
          s.pageName = `${requestorId}:home:${s.pageName}`
          s.contextData['tve.passactivation'] = 'true'
          s.contextData['tve.title'] =

          s.contextData['tve.passconfirmation'] = 'true'
          s.contextData['tve.title'] = 'Confirmation Screen'
          break
      }
    }
    s.linkTrackEvents = ''
    s.linkTrackVars = ''
    s.events = ''
    s.linkTrackEvents = ''
    s.t()
  }

    if (

        navigator.userAgent.match(/webOS/i) ||
        navigator.userAgent.match(/iPhone/i) ||
        navigator.userAgent.match(/iPad/i) ||

      if (

      ) {

          authModalType = null,
          modalName = null,
        } = data.dataset;

        const eventData = convertEventData({
          analyticId,

          modalName,
        });

        // Snowplow pixel
        if (eventData.snowplowId) {
          const addParams = new URLSearchParams({
            ...pixelConfig['snowplow'].staticParams,
            aid: eventData.snowplowId, // snowplow app id
          });

          const pixelUrl = new URL(`?${addParams.toString()}`, pixelConfig['snowplow'].baseURL);
          addPixel(pixelUrl.toString(), 'snowplow', [{ name: 'alt', value: '' }]);

        if (eventData.theTradeDeskId) {

How we determined CNBC’s Financial Advisor 100 ranking for 2025 
 CNBC’s Financial Advisor 100 list is determined through a blend of data analysis and editorial review.

As an initial screening, data provider AccuPoint Solutions analyzes core data points from its proprietary database of registered investment advisors, or RIAs, as well as the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission’s regulatory database. Firms that don’t meet CNBC’s proprietary criteria are removed from the list.

This year’s analysis used an initial list of 40,563 RIA firms. The list was eventually cut to 1,015 RIAs that met CNBC’s proprietary criteria.

CNBC sends an extensive email survey to all those firms that meet the initial criteria to gather more details about their practice. CNBC applies a layer of editorial review, clarifying firm entries as needed and verifying responses against the SEC regulatory database and other publicly available resources.

AccuPoint Solutions then applies CNBC’s proprietary weighted criteria to refine the list and rank the firms.

A firm’s inclusion on the list is based solely on this methodology. CNBC receives no compensation from placing financial advisory firms on our list. Additionally, a firm’s or advisor’s appearance on our ranking does not constitute an individual endorsement by CNBC of any firm or advisor.
Data that goes into CNBC’s Financial Advisor 100 

AccuPoint Solutions uses a variety of primary data points, either as a minimum baseline or within a range, to eliminate those firms that do not meet CNBC’s requirements. For example, any firm that has a disclosure with the SEC such as a regulatory violation or customer dispute is automatically disqualified from the ranking.

Once the initial list is compiled, weightings are also applied accordingly. 

These data points include:

    Advisory firm’s regulatory/compliance record
    Number of years in the business
    Number of certified financial planners
    Number of employees
    Number of investment advisors registered with the firm
    Ratio of investment advisors to the total number of employees
    Total assets under management
    Percentage of discretionary assets under management
    Total accounts under management
    Number of states where the RIA is registered
    Country of domicile

CNBC receives no compensation from placing financial advisory firms on our Financial Advisor 100 list. Additionally, a firm’s or advisor’s appearance in our ranking does not constitute an individual endorsement by CNBC of any firm or advisor.

island of Sardinia, is offering $1 homes and several other schemes to attract American expats.</p><p>The rural Italian village has been selling dilapidated houses for as little as <a href="https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/ollolai-italy-one-euro-homes/index.html" target="_blank">one euro since 2018</a>, and after the 2024 U.S. presidential election, it launched a <a href="https://www.liveinollolai.com/" target="_blank">website</a> offering up even more cheap homes.</p><div style="height:100%" class="lazyload-placeholder"></div><p>"Are you worned [worn] out by global politics? Looking to embrace a more balanced lifestyle while securing new opportunities," the website states. "It's time to start building your European escape in the stunning paradise of Sardinia."</p><p>Ollolai's mayor, Francesco Columbu, told <a href="https://www.cnn.com/2024/11/19/travel/italian-village-ollolai-wants-americans-election-one-dollar-homes/index.html" target="_blank">CNN</a> the website was created to lure Americans after the 2024 presidential elections.</p><p>"Of course, we can't specifically mention the name of one U.S. president who just got elected, but we all know that he's the one from whom many Americans want to get away from now and leave the country," Columbo said.</p><p>"We have specifically created this website now to meet U.S. post-elections relocation needs. The first edition of our digital nomad scheme, which launched last year, was already solely for Americans," he added.</p></div><div class="InlineImage-styles-makeit-imageEmbed--kbwfw" id="ArticleBody-InlineImage-108065657" data-test="InlineImage"><div class="InlineImage-styles-makeit-wrapper--AxC3F"><div class="InlineImage-styles-makeit-imagePlaceholder--KPr64" style="padding-bottom:55.55555555555556%"><div style="height:100%" class="lazyload-placeholder"></div></div><div class="InlineImage-styles-makeit-captionContainer--Ef7Yz"><div class="InlineImage-styles-makeit-imageEmbedCaption--mfcME">Ollolai is a village located in the Nuoro province of Sardinia, Italy.</div><div class="InlineImage-styles-makeit-imageEmbedCredit--SQGa6">Sebastiaan Kroes | Moment | Getty Images</div></div></div></div><div class="group"><p>Columbu said he is a big fan of the United States and thinks Americans are the best people to help revive Ollolai's community.</p><p>"We just really want, and will focus on, Americans above all. We can't of course ban people from other countries to apply, but Americans will have a fast-track procedure," he tells CNN. "We are betting on them to help us revive the village, they are our winning card."</p><p>The mayor said the village is offering three levels of accommodations:</p><ol><li>Free temporary homes to certain digital nomads</li><li>One-euro homes in need of renovations</li><li>Ready-to-occupy houses for up to 100,000 euros or about $106,000.</li></ol><p>Photos and plans of the available properties will be uploaded to the website soon, CNN reports.</p><p>Since launching the website, the mayor says they have received over 35,000 requests for more information on the houses, most of which were from the U.S.</p><p>Columbu said that since the scheme originally launched in 2018, they have sold 10 homes and have about 100 unoccupied cheap homes on sale and ready-to-move-in ones.</p><p><em>Conversions from euros to USD were done using the OANDA conversion rate of 1 euro to 1.05 USD on November 20, 2024. Looking to embrace a more balanced lifestyle while securing new opportunities,\" the website states. \"It's time to start building your European escape in the stunning paradise of Sardinia.\" Ollolai's mayor, Francesco Columbu, told CNN the website was created to lure Americans after the 2024 presidential elections. \"Of course, we can't specifically mention the name of one U.S. president who just got elected, but we all know that he's the one from whom many Americans want to get away from now and leave the country,\" Columbo said. \"We have specifically created this website now to meet U.S. post-elections relocation needs. The first edition of our digital nomad scheme, which launched last year, was already solely for Americans,\" he added. Columbu said he is a big fan of the United States and thinks Americans are the best people to help revive Ollolai's community. \"We just really want, and will focus on, Americans above all. Photos and plans of the available properties will be uploaded to the website soon, CNN reports. /* globals adobe, BI, Visitor */
(function() {
  var logEvent = (window.BI && BI.console && BI.console.build('ADB VisitorAPI')) || Function.prototype;

  var oneTrustConsent = (() => {
    let loaded;
    const _consentCATs = {
      8: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C8%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Social Media',
      },
      7: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C7%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Content Selection & Measurement',
      },
      6: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C6%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Device Storage',
      },
      4: {
        pattern: /groups=[^&]*%2C4%3A1/,
        enabled: false,
        desc: 'Targeted Advertising'
      },
    };

    const parseCookie = () => {
      loaded = (() => {
        let present = document.cookie.match(/^(.*;)?\s*OptanonConsent\s*=\s*[^;]+(.*)?$/);
        return present && present.length >= 1;
      })();

      let consentCookie =
        document &&
        document.cookie &&
        document.cookie
          .split(';')
          .map(s => s.trim())
          .find(s => s.startsWith('OptanonConsent'));

      Object.entries(_consentCATs).forEach(([k,v]) => {
        _consentCATs[k].enabled = v.pattern.test(consentCookie);
      });
    };
    parseCookie();

    return {
      loaded,
      enabledCATs: () => {
        let enabled = [];
        Object.entries(_consentCATs).forEach(([k,v]) => {
          if (v.enabled) enabled.push(k);
        });
        return enabled;
      },
      isEnabled: (category) => {
        return _consentCATs[category]?.enabled ?? false;
      },
      refresh: () => {
        parseCookie();
      }
    };
  })();

  //OneTrust GDPR Consent BEGIN
  var buildConfig = () => {
    var config = {};
    let { loaded, isEnabled } = oneTrustConsent;

    if (loaded) {
      config.previousPermissions = {};
      if (!isEnabled(8)) {
        // CAT 8: Social Media
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.LIVEFYRE] = false;
      }
      if (!isEnabled(7)) {
        // CAT 7: Content Selection & Measurement
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.AAM] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.ANALYTICS] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.CAMPAIGN] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.ECID] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.MEDIA_ANALYTICS] = false;
      }
      if (!isEnabled(6)) {
        // CAT 6: Storage
        config.disableThirdPartyCookies = true;
      }
      if (!isEnabled(4)) {
        // CAT 4: Targeted Advertising
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.ADCLOUD] = false;
        config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories.TARGET] = false;
      }
      if (isEnabled(4) && isEnabled(7)) {
        // Enable all categories as opted in
        // Effectively what was being done previously by adobe.optIn.approveAll();
        Object.keys(adobe.OptInCategories).forEach((category) => {
          config.previousPermissions[adobe.OptInCategories[category]] = true;
        });
      }
      if (isEnabled(6)) {
        config.disableThirdPartyCookies = false;
      }
    }
    return config;
  };
  //OneTrust GDPR Consent END

  var visitor = Visitor.getInstance('8CF467C25245AE3F0A490D4C@AdobeOrg', {
    trackingServer: 'o.fandango.com', // same as s.trackingServer
    trackingServerSecure: 'os.fandango.com', // same as s.trackingServerSecure
    marketingCloudServer: 'o.fandango.com',
    marketingCloudServerSecure: 'os.fandango.com',
    doesOptInApply: () => {
      // Broad strokes enables/disables opt-in flow
      return window?.Optanon?.GetDomainData?.().ForceConsent ?? !document.cookie.split(';').some((entry) => entry.includes('region=USA'));
    },
    disableThirdPartyCookies: true, // can be overwritten by builtConfig
    ...buildConfig(),
    // preOptInApprovals: preOptInApprovalsConfig,
    // previousPermissions: previousPermissionsConfig,
    // isOptInStorageEnabled: false
  });

  // Assign visitor instance to window in case it's a dependency elsewhere
  window.visitor = visitor;
  visitor.getVisitorValues((data) => {
    logEvent('Identity Values', data);
  });
})();

        resolve(undefined);
      }, timeLimit);

      BI.waitForObjAvailable(['__CNBC_META_DATA.user'], (timeLimit/100), function() {

/*global __CNBC_META_DATA, mps, adobe, Optanon, BI */
//Omni Setup
var s={};
var s_account='';
if (document.location.host == 'www.cnbc.com' || document.location.host == 'dealornodeal.cnbc.com' || document.location.host == 'activate.cnbc.com') {
  s_account='fancnbcglobal';
}else{
  s_account='fancnbcglobaldev';
}
var s_omniServer='o.fandango.com';
var s_omniSecureServer='os.fandango.com';
var s_linkInternalFilters='javascript:,cnbc.com,taboolainternal,cnbcevents.com,cnbccouncils.com,activate.cnbc.com';
var currentURL = window.location.href || '';
var requestorId = 'CNBC'
var device = ''
var pathname = ''
var activationPageTVEContentHub = 'Adobe Pass'
var activationPageTrackingEvents = {
    ACTIVATION_SCREEN: 'clientlessActivationScreen',
    CONFIRMATION_SCREEN: 'clientlessConfirmationScreen',
    MVPD_SELECTION     : 'mvpdSelection',
    MVPD_SELECTED      : 'mvpdSelected',
    ADOBE_PASS_LANDING : 'adobePassLanding',
    AUTHN_TRACK        : 'authnTrack',
    PASS_SIGNIN        : 'passsignin'
}

function deleteBedrockCookie() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return;
  }
  document.cookie = 'bedrocktrk=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT;path=/';
  document.cookie = 'bedrocktrk=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT;path=/;domain=.cnbc.com';
}

window.s = new AppMeasurement(s_account);

// Set up logic for App Measurement on new CNBC activation page
window.addEventListener('activationPageLoaded', function(event) {
  var trackEventType = event.detail
    _trackDeviceActivationPageLoadEvent(trackEventType)
})
window.addEventListener('activationPageTrackAuthEvent', function(event) {
  var {trackEventType, mvpdId, additionalAppMeasurementContextVariables} = event.detail
  _trackAuthEvents(trackEventType, mvpdId, additionalAppMeasurementContextVariables)
})

function _getDeviceType(pathName) {
  var ottPlatforms = ['firetv', 'androidtv', 'samsungtv', 'viziotv', 'x1', 'roku', 'tvos']
  ottPlatforms.forEach(platform => {
    if(pathName.includes(platform)){
      device = platform
    }
  })
}

function _setUpActivationPageTVE() {
    var s=s_gi(s_account)
    s.trackingServer=s_omniServer
    s.trackingServerSecure=s_omniSecureServer
    const days = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday']
    const timeEST = this._getDateTimeEST()
    const date = timeEST.getDate() + '-' + (timeEST.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + timeEST.getFullYear()
    const platform = this._isMobile() ? 'Mobile' : 'PC'
    _getDeviceType(window.location.pathname)
    s.pageName = requestorId+'- Watch Full Episodes |'+requestorId+'| Enter your activation code'
    s.contextData['tve.minute'] =
        timeEST.getHours() + ':' + timeEST.getMinutes()
    s.contextData['tve.hour'] = timeEST.getHours()
    s.contextData['tve.day'] = days[timeEST.getDay()]
    s.contextData['tve.date'] = date
    s.contextData['tve.platform'] = platform
    s.contextData['tve.domain'] = window.location.host
    s.contextData['tve.contenthub'] = activationPageTVEContentHub
    s.contextData['tve.app'] = device
    s.contextData['tve.clientlessdevice'] = device
    s.contextData['tve.passnetwork'] = requestorId
    s.contextData['tve.network'] = requestorId
}

function _trackPage(pageName) {
  _setUpActivationPageTVE()
  if (pageName) {
      s.pageName = pageName
  }
  if (s.contextData['tve.contenthub'] != activationPageTVEContentHub) {
    Object.keys(s.contextData).forEach((key) => {
      if (key === 'tve.pass') {
          delete s?.contextData[key]
      }
    })
  }
  s.linkTrackEvents = ''
  s.linkTrackVars = ''
  s.events = ''
  s.linkTrackEvents = ''
  s.t()
}

function _updateContextData(additionalVars) {
    var keys = '';
    s.contextData = {...s.contextData, ...additionalVars}
    Object.keys(additionalVars).forEach(key => keys = ',contextData.' + key)
    return keys;
}

function _trackEvent(events, linkName, linkVars) {
  _setUpActivationPageTVE()
  if (linkName.endsWith("Selected")){
      const brand = window.location.href.includes('ms.now') ? 'MSNOW' : 'CNBC'
      s.pageName = brand+":PC:" + s.pageName
  }
  s.events = events
  s.linkTrackEvents = events
  s.linkTrackVars = linkVars + ',contextData.tve.minute,contextData.tve.hour,contextData.tve.day,contextData.tve.date,contextData.tve.platform,contextData.tve.domain,contextData.tve.app,contextData.tve.passnetwork,contextData.tve.network'
  s.pev2 = linkName
  s.tl(true, 'o', linkName)
}

function _trackAuthEvents(eventType, mvpd_id, additionalVars) {
  s.contextData = {};
  s.contextData['tve.app'] = 'website'
  var platform = _isMobile() ? 'Mobile' : 'PC'

  if(additionalVars) {
    additionalKeys = _updateContextData(additionalVars);
  }

  s.contextData['tve.contenthub'] = activationPageTVEContentHub
  s.contextData['tve.passnetwork'] = requestorId
  s.contextData['tve.network'] = requestorId
  s.contextData['tve.clientlessdevice'] = device

  switch (eventType) {
    case activationPageTrackingEvents.MVPD_SELECTION: {
      s.contextData['tve.passmvpdselector'] = 'true'
      s.contextData['tve.title'] = 'Open MVPD Selector'
      s.contextData['tve.network']   = requestorId;
      _trackPage(requestorId + ':' + platform + ':Pass:' + 'Open MVPD Selector')
      break
    }
    case activationPageTrackingEvents.MVPD_SELECTED: {

      if (

      ) {

          authModalType = null,
          modalName = null,
        } = data.dataset;

        const eventData = convertEventData({
          analyticId,

          modalName,
        });

        // Snowplow pixel
        if (eventData.snowplowId) {
          const addParams = new URLSearchParams({
            ...pixelConfig['snowplow'].staticParams,
            aid: eventData.snowplowId, // snowplow app id
          });

          const pixelUrl = new URL(`?${addParams.toString()}`, pixelConfig['snowplow'].baseURL);
          addPixel(pixelUrl.toString(), 'snowplow', [{ name: 'alt', value: '' }]);

        if (eventData.theTradeDeskId) {

This village in Italy is offering $1 homes to Americans looking to move abroad post-election 
 Ollolai, a village on the Italian island of Sardinia, is offering $1 homes and several other schemes to attract American expats.

The rural Italian village has been selling dilapidated houses for as little as one euro since 2018, and after the 2024 U.S. presidential election, it launched a website offering up even more cheap homes.

“Are you worned [worn] out by global politics? Looking to embrace a more balanced lifestyle while securing new opportunities,” the website states. “It’s time to start building your European escape in the stunning paradise of Sardinia.”

Ollolai’s mayor, Francesco Columbu, told CNN the website was created to lure Americans after the 2024 presidential elections.

“Of course, we can’t specifically mention the name of one U.S. president who just got elected, but we all know that he’s the one from whom many Americans want to get away from now and leave the country,” Columbo said.

“We have specifically created this website now to meet U.S. post-elections relocation needs. The first edition of our digital nomad scheme, which launched last year, was already solely for Americans,” he added.
Columbu said he is a big fan of the United States and thinks Americans are the best people to help revive Ollolai’s community.

“We just really want, and will focus on, Americans above all. We can’t of course ban people from other countries to apply, but Americans will have a fast-track procedure,” he tells CNN. “We are betting on them to help us revive the village, they are our winning card.”

The mayor said the village is offering three levels of accommodations:

1. Free temporary homes to certain digital nomads
2. One-euro homes in need of renovations
3. Ready-to-occupy houses for up to 100,000 euros or about $106,000.
Photos and plans of the available properties will be uploaded to the website soon, CNN reports.

Since launching the website, the mayor says they have received over 35,000 requests for more information on the houses, most of which were from the U.S.

Columbu said that since the scheme originally launched in 2018, they have sold 10 homes and have about 100 unoccupied cheap homes on sale and ready-to-move-in ones.

Conversions from euros to USD were done using the OANDA conversion rate of 1 euro to 1.05 USD on November 20, 2024. All amounts are rounded to the nearest dollar.
